shapes.name: Holding
shapes.description: This racer's inventory of one PieceType, in individual piece units (never packs). about = the catalog PieceType (canonical cross-repo wref into slotcars/carrera-catalog, e.g. wh:slotcars/carrera-catalog/PieceType/straight/full). One Holding per piece type; quantity changes are revisions (append-only history shows the collection growing).

condition.description: Free text: new / worn / broken tabs etc.

acquiredNotes.description: Provenance: which products/sets these pieces came from

pieceTypeSlug.description: Denormalized catalog piece type path, e.g. straight/full

shapes.name: Room
shapes.description: A physical space layouts must fit. One truth per room; revise as furniture moves.

obstacles.description: Rectangles the track must avoid, encoded 'xMm,yMm,widthMm,lengthMm,label' (origin at room corner)

shapes.name: Layout
shapes.description: A designed or built track. The ordered piece sequence is canonical data here (one artifact, versioned); per-piece traversal lives in PieceUsage assertions, regenerated deterministically from sequence on every revise — stale PieceUsage is a bug.

description.description: Design intent, who it is for

sequence.description: Ordered pieces encoded '<pieceTypeSlug>[:L|R]' — hand L/R for curves, omitted for straights; e.g. 'curve/r1-60:L', 'straight/full'. Closure-checked by the solver before save

laneLengthsMm.description: Per-slot lengths computed by the solver

footprintWidthMm.description: Bounding box incl. 99 mm half-width each side

roomWref.description: Room this was designed for (local wref)

closureVerified.description: Solver closure result at save time

status.description: designed | built | retired — in data, never in the name

shapes.name: PieceUsage
shapes.description: Materialized bill of materials: how many of each PieceType a Layout consumes. about = Pair (Layout first, catalog PieceType second, canonical wref). Deterministically regenerated from Layout.sequence on every revise — never hand-edited. Query from either endpoint needs resolveCollections:true.

quantity.description: Pieces of this type the layout uses

shapes.name: BuildLog
shapes.description: Evidence that a design met reality: one entry per physical build/race session, authored by the repo owner. about = the Layout. This is the stream that keeps DesignBeliefs honest. For other people's takes, use LayoutFeedback.

issues.description: Closure failed IRL, piece shortage, car flies off at curve 4, ...

photos.description: Links only — the graph never owns image bytes

shapes.name: LayoutFeedback
shapes.description: Someone's take on a Layout — distinct from BuildLog (the owner's own build evidence). about = the Layout. Works two ways: repo members add it here directly; anyone else asserts the same shape FROM THEIR OWN repo about this repo's Layout by canonical wref — cross-repo assertions surface on the layout's about-query either way. Author identity also lives in commit metadata; authorName is the readable denormalization.

raceTested.description: true = author physically built/raced this layout; false = armchair review of the plan

layoutSlug.description: Denormalized layout name for context-free readability

shapes.name: Topic
shapes.description: Description-only anchor for design beliefs (flow, kid-friendly, overtaking, ...). Create sparingly; reuse existing topics.

shapes.name: DesignBelief
shapes.description: What this racer believes makes a good track, as a soft constraint for the designer skill. about = a Topic. Attributed, revisable; strength is the author's current subjective weight (single-author repo — no aggregation semantics). If beliefs ever get crowdsourced, promote to binomial propositions with certainty opinions.

strength.description: 0-1 subjective weight the solver applies as a soft objective

evidenceLayoutWrefs.description: Layouts whose BuildLogs support or contradict this belief

data.title: Flow
data.note: Rhythm of the racing line: sweepers vs stop-and-go

data.title: Kid-friendly
data.note: Forgiving layouts for young or new racers: fewer deslots, wide shoulders

data.title: Overtaking
data.note: Passing opportunities: lane-change placement, straight length before corners (digital)
